title: PERFORM N TIMES — N evaluated ONCE before the first iteration; mutating N inside is ignored
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GROW-AND-PROCESS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-N      PIC 9(3).
       01  WS-CTR    PIC 9(3).
      *> PERFORM N TIMES evaluates N ONCE at entry. Re-assigning
      *> WS-N inside the loop does NOT change the iteration count.
      *> Java's for-loop with a re-read 'for(i=0; i<N; i++)' would
      *> -- a literal port might silently increase the loop count.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE 5 TO WS-N.
           PERFORM ADD-ONE WS-N TIMES.
           STOP RUN.
       ADD-ONE.
           ADD 1 TO WS-CTR.
           IF WS-CTR > 3 ADD 1 TO WS-N.
notes: Same trap as Fortran DO loop iteration count. The for-loop port in Java/C# re-reads the bound each iteration, which silently changes behaviour. The spec must capture the freeze-at-entry semantic.
